project_boundary.traction_pack: professionally built or qualified integrated system only
project_boundary.hot_swap: not allowed unless the selected qualified system explicitly supports it
project_boundary.dock: mechanical alignment/service fixture only; not a substitute BMS or charger

range.goal: long exploration configuration with explicit mass trade

charger_references.compatibility_rule: reference only; exact pack compatibility must be confirmed from selected system documentation
MBS explicitly markets this as the ultimate upgrade for the AGENT 1080; do not infer 540 compatibility

product_benchmarks.lesson: consumer charging should feel routine and predictable; published charge time remains system-specific

safety_references.role: battery systems for light electric vehicle applications
electrical systems for personal e-mobility devices including e-skateboards

dock_architecture.name: passive alignment charge cradle
dock_architecture.electrical_principle: preserve the selected pack/charger electrical interface; dock adds no independent charging power stage
mechanical_features: self-centering guides that do not load wheel/brake/drive hardware
floating charger-plug carriage or one-handed mechanical mating aid
service access without lifting the board
prohibited: unqualified pogo-pin or magnetic traction-charge contacts
using the dock to discover charger compatibility

everyday.target_soc_policy: use a reduced daily target only if the selected BMS/charger explicitly supports it

long_trip.target_soc_policy: full trip charge when supported and needed
long_trip.installed_energy_goal: range class or qualified cold-swap strategy
long_trip.rationale: maximize mission margin without permanently carrying range mass

storage.target_soc_policy: follow selected battery manufacturer/builder storage instructions

experimental_invariants: Range claims remain planning envelopes until qualified X1 telemetry exists.
Energy/power arithmetic provides only an ideal charge-time lower bound, never an actual full-charge promise.
Pack mass and CG are mechanical design inputs and must be requalified when pack class changes.
A larger battery cannot compensate for insufficient braking, traction, thermal margin, or retention.
No live battery is used for enclosure impact or clearance discovery.
The dock cannot create compatibility that the selected battery and charger do not already have.
